LanguageData.FixWorld_logs_shareConfirmMessage:
Upload game logs now?

This will post your game logs to a public server and give you the link to share with others. This is useful if you need help fixing a problem or would like to report an issue to a mod author.

No private information will be shared.
LanguageData.FixWorld_logs_shortUrls_tip: Produces a shorter link when uploading. Not recommended on Steam- short links are automatically removed.
LanguageData.FixWorld_logs_platformInfo_tip: Includes information about your CPU, memory and video card in the log.
LanguageData.FixWorld_logs_unlimitedLogSize_tip: When disabled, log size is limited to 10K lines to prevent very long logs from causing issues.
LanguageData.FixWorld_logs_github_token_tip: Publishes logs to your own GitHub account when set. Paste a token from GitHub > Settings > Developer Settings > Personal access tokens. Leave blank to publish to the public FixWorld account.\n\nLogs published to your account can only be viewed by others using a link.

LanguageData.FixWorld_loadOrderWarning_text: The FixWorld mod should always be loaded after Core to avoid issues.\nPlease adjust your mod order in the Mods menu and restart the game.
